name: Wayne Wire
old_description: Since 1943, Wayne Wire Cloth Products has been the trusted supplier of high-quality filtration components to Fortune 500 companies worldwide.
about:
Wayne Wire Cloth Products, Inc. was founded in 1943 in Wayne, Michigan, and established its headquarters in Kalkaska, Michigan in 1950. The company was purchased by its current owners in 1996 and has since expanded to manufacturing operations in Hillman, Michigan, and Juarez, Mexico.

The company produces precision wire cloth and filtration components, including expanded foil mesh, custom fabricated assemblies, welded and brazed parts, and machined components. Its capabilities span manual and automated pressing, rolling, convolution, shearing, TIG/MIG/resistance welding, silver and nickel/gold brazing, vacuum furnace brazing, ultrasonic cleaning, and comprehensive inspection. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Kalkaska and Hillman, Michigan, and Juarez, Mexico, supporting both prototype and high-volume production.

Wayne Wire serves aerospace and defense (NADCAP and AS9100D certified), automotive and transportation (including Tier 1 suppliers and supplemental restraint systems), medical devices, HVAC and refrigeration, water systems, and energy sectors. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 companies worldwide.

The company emphasizes zero-defect manufacturing for safety-critical components, rapid prototyping for design validation, and a quality management system built on 80-plus years of precision manufacturing experience.
